topics.name: nanoCMS Site Identity
topics.purpose: Define each nanoCMS site as an explicit structure identity owning web hierarchy, routes/navigation metadata and MetaModule placement only.

semantics.identity_rule: Each site has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.ownership_rule: Site owns web structure/navigation/placement metadata, not domain or MetaModule internal semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Site ownership does not grant underlying MetaModule/domain authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: folder tree used as site identity
web instance and site identity conflated
